main_text.l: CXXI. Florebat ea ætate in Gallia Robertus Gallus,
quem Possevinus in Appar. Tom. 2. Excellentem verbi Divini
concionatorem vocat. Ejus extat libellus Lutetiæ cum Hil-

complexus. Cap. 5. Papam Idolum diserte vocat, his ver-
bis Deum loquentem inducens: Quis posuit Idolum hoc in
sede mea, ut imperaret gregi meo? Sed & cap. I. ac 12. sub
serpentis nomine Papam ceu Antichristum describit, qui
se supra modum extollit, pios quosque opprimat,
multis Pseudoprohetis circumseptus, qui in contemptum
Dei & Christi eum solum prædicent & extollant, Jesu
contrà nomen obscurent. Demum Ecclesiam Romanam

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are italic and were transcribed as notes. Some words in the text are doubtful, notably "Pseudoprohetis" and "Rolevinccii", as printed. "Formia" printed for "forma" and "Jesu" as printed; no other marks.
